title: Have been subscribed since added on Amazon. Products are good, Costumer Service is TERRIBLE
text: They have sent many products that I enjoy! I love checking out the youtube videos and seeing what I am going to expect this month. Last month I did not receive the knife described both on youtube and on their flyer inside the box. Contacted customer service hoping maybe to at least get free shipping on purchase of promised knife. They just told me amazon customers got a different knife and I am SOL. The youtube channel rants about how they contacted everyone. Except those who order via amazon.  Then this month I am expecting a knife and some scales that are supposed to come with it. Well guess what without notification again they send me stuff not on the box and exclude stuff from the box. In this case they substituted a leather sheath. However, the leather sheath was supposed to be for limited time additional purchase with limited free shipping. So I had already purchased the sheath causing me to get a duplicate. Now I have two sheaths and no scales. Tried to return one of the sheaths. Guess what I am SOL because I am an amazon customer. Stay away based on the customer service alone. Sucks cause I did like the products.
label: negative
